items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A simple ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's moisture barrier and suits a young, oily-feeling complexion.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is the most useful step for keeping skin looking youthful over the long term.

response.routine_note: Cleanse and moisturize morning and night, then apply sunscreen every morning and reapply if you're outdoors. I've left out vitamin C and the firming cream because they aren't needed at 15, and your scan scores already look healthy in appearance.
